subject: Six oak chairs for the reading room
body:
Hello Tom,

We would like six oak chairs for the reading room at Birch Hall, the same
design as the pair you made for the library last year.
Could you send us a price and a delivery date for the six chairs?

Kind regards,
Rosa Lind, facilities manager at Birch Hall

subject: Re: Six oak chairs for the reading room
body:
Dear Rosa,

Thank you for asking us again. Our price for the six oak chairs is 2,400
dollars, including finishing, and we can deliver them by the end of April.
The offer stands for thirty days; tell us if you would like to go ahead.

Best wishes,
Tom Avery, Alder and Pine Workshop

subject: Re: Six oak chairs for the reading room
body:
Hello Tom,

The board approved it this morning: please go ahead with the six oak chairs
at 2,400 dollars, delivered by the end of April as you proposed.
Our purchase order will follow by post this week.

Thanks again,
Rosa

subject: Walnut bookcase
body:
Tom,

I am sorry to say we have to cancel the walnut bookcase we ordered in
January for the shop front. The lease on the new unit fell through, so we
have nowhere to put it this year.
Please let Ana know what we owe you for the timber you have already cut.

Ivo Marsh, Quay Market
